rules.statement: An architecture decision record's Decision section must state the rule it decides or applies in its own words, citing any upstream record it applies, and must not open with a pronoun or reference to text that is no longer in the record.
rules.why: A reader of the record alone should be able to tell what is being enforced without following links; a dangling reference left after trimming makes the record read as incomplete.
rules.check: In edited ADRs under docs/decisions, check that the Decision section begins by naming the rule, and that no sentence opens with a pronoun such as "Its" or "This" whose antecedent was deleted.
